questions.stem_text:
The size of the labor force in Japan is expected to shrink beginning in 2010 as a large
segment of its population retires. This will

options.A: affect labor productivity more than economic growth.
options.B: affect economic growth more than labor productivity.
options.C: not have a major effect on economic growth or labor productivity.
options.D: affect labor productivity and economic growth equally.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - affect economic growth more than labor productivity.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following policies best describes supply-side fiscal policy?

options.A: An increase in the money supply
options.C: Lower taxes on research and development of new technology

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Lower taxes on research and development of new technology

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following might explain how a price decrease might cause a decrease in
quantity demanded and an upward-sloping demand curve?

options.A: The good is inferior and the income effect is stronger than the substitution effect.
options.B: The good is normal and the income effect is stronger than the substitution effect.
options.C: The good is normal and the income effect is weaker than the substitution effect.
options.D: The good is inferior and a luxury.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The good is inferior and the income effect is stronger than the substitution effect.

questions.stem_text: Country A has a current account surplus; this means that

options.A: Country A also has a financial account surplus.
options.B: Country A has a financial account deficit.
options.C: Country A must borrow from its foreign reserves.
options.D: Country A is operating in a recessionary gap.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Country A has a financial account deficit.

questions.stem_text: Opportunity costs or implicit costs of a "Mom \& Pop"-owned business are:

options.C: equal to earnings or profits that could have occurred using resources elsewhere.
options.D: equal to earnings or profits that occurred for Mom \& Pop's business.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - equal to earnings or profits that could have occurred using resources elsewhere.
